sentences.text: Inland rules add one more distress signal: a high-intensity white light flashing at regular intervals from fifty to seventy times per minute.
Using any of these signals except to indicate distress and need of assistance is prohibited, as is using any signal that might be confused with them.
A favorite exam question lists four signals and asks which one is not a distress signal.
Watch for traps like three short blasts, a green flare, or a white flare.
A continuously sounding fog horn is, and so is orange smoke.
